verdict.rationale: New Relic documents an official MCP server that lets AI development tools connect directly to platform context, and it turns plain-English questions into NRQL queries. A probe confirms the official MCP server page exists. The evidence is limited to a what's-new announcement rather than in-depth setup documentation. missing for 10: detailed connection/setup and authentication docs, enumerated tool list or scope of operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This update provides a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results
